mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status IN ('2', '3', '8') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status IN ('4', '5', '6', '10') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminated FROM flow_instance i WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.create_time >= #{timeStart} AND i.create_time <= #{timeEnd}

SELECT d.id AS definitionId, d.flow_name AS flowName, d.flow_code AS flowCode, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status IN ('2', '3', '8') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN i.flow_status IN ('4', '5', '6', '10') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminated FROM flow_instance i LEFT JOIN flow_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.create_time >= #{timeStart} AND i.create_time <= #{timeEnd} GROUP BY d.id, d.flow_name, d.flow_code ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.node_code AS nodeCode, h.node_name AS nodeName, SUM(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'REJECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectCount, AVG(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'PASS' THEN a.dur END) AS avgDwellSeconds, MAX(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'PASS' THEN a.dur END) AS maxDwellSeconds FROM flow_his_task h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id AS hid, AS dur FROM flow_his_task a ) a ON a.hid = h.id WHERE h.del_flag = '0' AND h.definition_id = #{definitionId} GROUP BY h.node_code, h.node_name ORDER BY passCount DESC

SELECT u.processed_by AS processedBy, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS pendingCount FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_user u ON u.associated = t.id AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.type IN ('1', '2', '3') WHERE t.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY u.processed_by ORDER BY pendingCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN h.skip_type = 'REJECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectCount FROM flow_his_task h WHERE h.del_flag = '0' AND h.definition_id = #{definitionId} AND h.node_code = #{nodeCode}
